in_text_mentions: The Rokitansky nodule is the most common sonographic typical finding and is seen as a densely echogenic protuberance projecting into the cystic lumen (Fig. 1) [5]. This nodule, which is also called a dermoid plug, may show acoustic shadowing due to hair, teeth and the fat content (Fig. 2) [18]. Although it is described as a rounded solid mass, a bridge across the cyst or a thickened segment of the wall, it may rarely appear completely cystic (Fig. 3) [19, 20]. The Rokitansky nodule is a common site of malignant transformation and should be sectioned appropriately during pathologic analysis [1]

panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 6 panels (a, b, c, d, e, f). a: Panel a is T1WI portion of abdominopelvic MRI of giant ovarian mature cystic teratoma showing floating balls with layered signal, which is synonymous with fat signal with floating balls sign. b: Panel b is T2WI showing multiple floating spherules with layered signal, classic floating balls sign of ovarian dermoid cyst. c: Panel c is CE-T1WI FS showing suppression of high T1 signal, confirming fat content in ovarian mature cystic teratoma. d: Panel d is CE-T1WI FS axial with red arrow showing fat suppression, direct evidence of fat signal in dermoid floating balls. e: Panel e is DWI showing hyperintense floating spherules within giant ovarian mature cystic teratoma, visibly demonstrating the floating balls manifestation. f: Panel f is color ADC map showing low ADC dark blue spherules, visibly demonstrating the floating balls manifestation of ovarian dermoid cyst.

panels.figure_caption: Abdominopelvic MRI findings. (a-b) T1WI and T2WI show layered signal patterns of the balls. (c-d) CE-T1WI FS shows mild capsular enhancement and suppression of high T1 signal (red arrow in d), confirming fat content. (e-f) DWI and color ADC demonstrate restricted diffusion within the spherules (low ADC values in dark blue).
in_text_mentions: exa. The floating balls showed layered signal patterns: peripheral rim isointense on T1WI (T1-weighted imaging) and slightly hyperintense on T2WI, with a central core hypointense on T1WI and hyperintense on T2WI (Fig. 3a, b). CE-T1WI FS (Contrast-Enhanced T1-Weighted Imaging with Fat Saturation) showed mild capsular enhancement. Crucially, suppression of the high T1 signal from the spheres was observed (Fig. 3c, d), confirming their fat content. Diffusion-Weighted Imaging (DWI) and Apparent Diffusion Coefficient (ADC) imaging demonstrated restricted diffusion within the spherules (Fig. 3e, f).
